_info: Tréner Pravda, alebo nepravda? Kľúč = hodnota 'pravdaNepravda' v lekcii. tabulka = plán (riadky: [deň, činnosť, true = robí / false = nerobí]; pri "znaky": false len [deň, obsah], napr. rozvrh); polozky: t = veta, k = 't' (pravda) alebo 'f' (nepravda), v = vysvetlenie, sk = preklad (nepovinné).

mia-week.uvod: Toto je Miin týždenný plán. Mia hovorí o sebe – I = Mia.

polozky.t: I have a music lesson every Monday.
polozky.v: V pondelok má Mia have a music lesson a pri tom je ✓ → pravda.

polozky.t: I go swimming every Tuesday.
polozky.v: V utorok je pri go swimming ✗ – Mia v utorok nepláva.

polozky.t: I visit my grandma every Wednesday.
polozky.v: V stredu je pri visit my grandma ✓ → pravda.

polozky.t: I watch TV every Thursday.
polozky.v: Vo štvrtok je pri watch TV ✗ – Mia telku nepozerá.

polozky.t: I help my mum every Friday.
polozky.v: V piatok je pri help my mum ✓ → pravda.

polozky.t: I help my mum every Monday.
polozky.v: V pondelok má Mia hodinu hudby. Mame pomáha v piatok.

polozky.t: I visit my grandma every Friday.
polozky.v: Babku navštevuje v stredu. V piatok pomáha mame.

polozky.t: I don't watch TV.
polozky.v: Pri watch TV je ✗ → Mia telku nepozerá. I don't watch TV je pravda.

polozky.t: I don't go swimming.
polozky.v: Pri go swimming je ✗ → I don't go swimming je pravda.

polozky.t: I don't visit my grandma.
polozky.v: Pri visit my grandma je ✓ – Mia babku navštevuje (v stredu).

polozky.t: I don't have a music lesson.
polozky.v: Pri have a music lesson je ✓ – Mia ju má (v pondelok).

polozky.t: I don't help my mum.
polozky.v: Pri help my mum je ✓ – Mia mame pomáha (v piatok).

rozvrh-4a.uvod: Toto je rozvrh triedy 4.A. Hovoria žiaci zo 4.A – we = 4.A.

polozky.t: We've got English on Monday.
polozky.v: V pondelok je v rozvrhu maths, English → pravda.

polozky.t: We've got PE on Monday.
polozky.v: V pondelok je maths a English. Telesnú (PE) máme vo štvrtok a v piatok.

polozky.t: We've got art on Tuesday.
polozky.v: V utorok je v rozvrhu science, art → pravda.

polozky.t: We've got music on Wednesday.
polozky.v: V stredu je v rozvrhu English, music → pravda.

polozky.t: We've got science on Wednesday.
polozky.v: Prírodovedu (science) máme v utorok, nie v stredu.

polozky.t: We've got maths on Thursday.
polozky.v: Vo štvrtok je v rozvrhu maths, PE → pravda.

polozky.t: We've got art on Friday.
polozky.v: V piatok je music a PE. Výtvarnú (art) máme v utorok.

polozky.t: We've got PE on Friday.
polozky.v: V piatok je v rozvrhu music, PE → pravda.

polozky.t: On Wednesday we've got maths.
polozky.v: V stredu je English a music. Matematiku máme v pondelok a vo štvrtok.

polozky.t: What have we got on Thursday? – We've got maths and PE.
polozky.sk: Čo máme vo štvrtok? – Máme matematiku a telesnú.
polozky.v: Vo štvrtok je naozaj maths, PE → pravda.

polozky.t: What have we got on Tuesday? – We've got English.
polozky.sk: Čo máme v utorok? – Máme angličtinu.
polozky.v: V utorok je science a art. Angličtinu máme v pondelok a v stredu.

polozky.t: When have we got music? – On Monday.
polozky.v: Hudobnú (music) máme v stredu a v piatok, nie v pondelok.

polozky.t: When have we got science? – On Tuesday.
polozky.v: Science je v rozvrhu len v utorok → pravda.

preklad-this-that.uvod: Sedí slovenský preklad s anglickou vetou? Pozor na blízko / ďaleko a na jednu vec / viac vecí.

polozky.t: This is a computer. = Toto je počítač.
That is a board. = Toto je tabuľa.
These are tables. = Toto sú stoly.
Those are pegs. = Toto je vešiak.
polozky.v: Those are = tamto sú, viac vecí. Správne: Tamto sú vešiaky.

polozky.t: This is my pencil case. = Toto je môj peračník.
Those are computers. = Tamto sú počítače.
These are pegs. = Tamto sú vešiaky.
That is a classroom. = Tamto je trieda.
This is a table. = Toto sú stoly.
polozky.v: This is = toto je – jedna vec. Správne: Toto je stôl.

polozky.t: Those are boards. = Tamto je tabuľa.
polozky.v: Those are = tamto sú – viac vecí. Správne: Tamto sú tabule.

pocity.uvod: V tabuľke vidíš, ako sa kto cíti. Prečítaj otázku aj odpoveď a rozhodni, či odpoveď sedí s tabuľkou.

polozky.t: Are Tom and Ben happy? – Yes, they are.
polozky.sk: Sú Tom a Ben šťastní? – Áno, sú.
polozky.v: V tabuľke: Tom and Ben – happy → pravda.

polozky.t: Are the babies hungry? – Yes, they are.
Are Mia and Lucy hot? – Yes, they are.
polozky.sk: Je Mii a Lucy horúco? – Áno.
polozky.v: Mia a Lucy sú cold (je im zima), nie hot.

polozky.t: Are Grandma and Grandpa tired? – No, they aren't.
polozky.sk: Sú babka a dedko unavení? – Nie.
polozky.v: V tabuľke sú tired → správne je Yes, they are.

polozky.t: Are Max and Sam thirsty? – Yes, they are.
polozky.sk: Sú Max a Sam smädní? – Áno, sú.

polozky.t: Are Tom and Ben sad? – No, they aren't.
polozky.sk: Sú Tom a Ben smutní? – Nie, nie sú.
polozky.v: Tom a Ben sú happy, nie sad → No, they aren't je pravda.

polozky.t: Are the babies thirsty? – Yes, they are.
Are Mia and Lucy cold? – No, they aren't.
polozky.sk: Je Mii a Lucy zima? – Nie.
polozky.v: Mia a Lucy sú cold → správne je Yes, they are.

polozky.t: Are Max and Sam happy? – No, they aren't.
polozky.sk: Sú Max a Sam šťastní? – Nie.
polozky.v: Max a Sam sú thirsty, nie happy → pravda.

polozky.t: Are Grandma and Grandpa hungry? – Yes, they are.
polozky.sk: Sú babka a dedko hladní? – Áno.
polozky.v: Babka a dedko sú tired (unavení), nie hungry.

what-can-tom-do.uvod: Toto je Tom. V tabuľke vidíš, čo vie a čo nevie. Vety hovoria o Tomovi – he = Tom.

polozky.t: He can ride a bike.
He can ride a horse.
polozky.v: Pri ride a horse je ✗ → Tom to nevie.

polozky.t: He can't skate.
polozky.v: Pri skate je ✗ → he can't skate je pravda.

polozky.t: He can't play tennis.
polozky.v: Pri play tennis je ✓ → Tom tenis hrať vie.

polozky.t: He can play football.
Can he skate? – Yes, he can.
polozky.v: Pri skate je ✗ → správne je No, he can't.

polozky.t: Can he play tennis? – Yes, he can.
Can he ride a horse? – No, he can't.
polozky.sk: Vie jazdiť na koni? – Nie, nevie.

polozky.t: Can he ride a bike? – No, he can't.
polozky.v: Pri ride a bike je ✓ → správne je Yes, he can.

polozky.t: He can't play football.
polozky.v: Pri play football je ✓ → Tom futbal hrať vie.

lunch.uvod: Rosy a Billy majú obed. V tabuľke vidíš, čo kto má (✓) a čo nemá (✗). She = Rosy, he = Billy.

polozky.t: Has Rosy got a pizza? – Yes, she has.
Has Rosy got a salad? – Yes, she has.
polozky.v: Rosy – a salad ✗ → správne je No, she hasn't.

polozky.t: Has she got a milkshake? – Yes, she has.
Has Billy got fries? – No, he hasn't.
polozky.v: Billy – fries ✓ → správne je Yes, he has.

polozky.t: Has he got chicken? – Yes, he has.
Has Billy got a cheese sandwich? – No, he hasn't.
polozky.sk: Má Billy syrový sendvič? – Nie, nemá.

polozky.t: Rosy has got a salad.
polozky.v: Pri Rosy je a salad ✗ – šalát nemá.

polozky.t: Billy has got chicken and fries.
Has Rosy got a pizza and a milkshake? – Yes, she has.
polozky.sk: Má Rosy pizzu aj kokteil? – Áno, má.

polozky.t: Has Billy got a milkshake? – Yes, he has.
polozky.v: Pri Billym kokteil v tabuľke nie je – má fries, chicken (a cheese sandwich ✗).

birthday-likes.uvod: Billy a Rosy majú narodeniny. V tabuľke vidíš, čo majú radi (✓) a čo nie (✗). He = Billy, she = Rosy.

polozky.t: Billy likes chocolate.
Billy likes balloons.
polozky.v: Billy – balloons ✗ → Billy doesn't like balloons.

polozky.t: He doesn't like cake.
Rosy likes sweets.
She doesn't like cake.
Rosy doesn't like balloons.
What does Billy like? – He likes cake.
polozky.sk: Čo má Billy rád? – Má rád tortu.

polozky.t: What does Rosy like? – She likes cake.
polozky.sk: Čo má Rosy rada? – Má rada tortu.
polozky.v: Rosy – cake ✗. Rosy má rada sweets a balloons.

polozky.t: Billy and Rosy like cake.
polozky.sk: Billy a Rosy majú radi tortu.

polozky.t: Billy doesn't like balloons, but Rosy likes balloons.
polozky.sk: Billy nemá rád balóny, ale Rosy áno.

toms-day.uvod: Toto je Tomov deň. V tabuľke vidíš, o koľkej čo robí. He = Tom.

polozky.t: He gets up at seven o'clock.
He gets up at six o'clock.
He has breakfast at eight o'clock.
He goes to school at nine o'clock.
He goes home at two o'clock.
He has dinner at seven o'clock.
He goes to bed at nine o'clock.
He has dinner at six o'clock.
He goes to bed at eight o'clock.
He goes home at three o'clock.

kto-kde-pracuje.uvod: V tabuľke vidíš, kde kto pracuje. Prečítaj otázku aj odpoveď a rozhodni, či odpoveď sedí s tabuľkou.

polozky.t: Where does Mr Green work? – He works in a hospital.
polozky.sk: Kde pracuje pán Green? – V nemocnici.

polozky.t: Where does Mrs Brown work? – She works in a school.
polozky.sk: Kde pracuje pani Brown? – V škole.

polozky.t: Does Mr Black work in a police station? – Yes, he does.
polozky.sk: Pracuje pán Black na polícii? – Áno.

polozky.t: Does Miss White work in a hospital? – Yes, she does.
polozky.sk: Pracuje slečna White v nemocnici? – Áno.
polozky.v: Miss White pracuje v škole → No, she doesn't.

polozky.t: Does Mr Red work in an airport? – Yes, he does.
polozky.sk: Pracuje pán Red na letisku? – Áno.

polozky.t: Does Mrs Brown work in a shop? – No, she doesn't.
polozky.sk: Pracuje pani Brown v obchode? – Nie.

polozky.t: Does Mr Green work in a school? – No, he doesn't.
polozky.sk: Pracuje pán Green v škole? – Nie.
polozky.v: Mr Green pracuje v nemocnici → No, he doesn't je pravda.

polozky.t: Where does Miss White work? – She works in a school.
polozky.sk: Kde pracuje slečna White? – V škole.

polozky.t: Where does Mr Red work? – He works in a fire station.
polozky.sk: Kde pracuje pán Red? – Na hasičskej stanici.

polozky.t: Does Mr Black work in an airport? – No, he doesn't.
polozky.sk: Pracuje pán Black na letisku? – Nie.
polozky.v: Mr Black pracuje na polícii → No, he doesn't je pravda.

pocasie-oblecenie.uvod: V tabuľke vidíš počasie v jednotlivé dni. Rozhodni, či veta sedí s počasím a či je rada rozumná.

polozky.t: On Monday it's sunny.
On Tuesday it's snowing.
On Wednesday it's snowing.
On Thursday it's hot.
On Friday it's hot.
Tuesday: It's raining. Put on your sun hat.
polozky.sk: Utorok: Prší. Daj si slnečný klobúk.
polozky.v: Prší → slnečný klobúk nepomôže. Lepšie: Put on your raincoat.

polozky.t: Wednesday: It's snowing. Put on your gloves.
polozky.v: Sneží → rukavice sú dobrá rada → pravda.

polozky.t: Friday: It's hot. Don't put on your coat.
polozky.sk: Piatok: Je horúco. Neobliekaj si kabát.

polozky.t: Monday: It's sunny. Don't put on your sun hat.
polozky.sk: Pondelok: Je slnečno. Nedávaj si klobúk.
polozky.v: Slnečno → klobúk sa hodí: Put on your sun hat.

polozky.t: What's the weather like on Thursday? – It's windy.
polozky.sk: Aké je počasie vo štvrtok? – Fúka vietor.

kto-co-nosi.uvod: V tabuľke vidíš, čo má kto dnes na sebe. Prečítaj otázku aj odpoveď a rozhodni, či sedí s tabuľkou.

riadky: a blue skirt, a red scarf

polozky.t: What's Milly wearing? – She's wearing red trousers.
polozky.sk: Čo má Milly na sebe? – Červené nohavice.

polozky.t: What's Joe wearing? – He's wearing a blue skirt.
polozky.sk: Čo má Joe na sebe? – Modrú sukňu.
polozky.v: Joe má jeans a yellow shirt. Modrú sukňu má Grandma.

polozky.t: Grandma's wearing a red scarf.
Tim's wearing black boots.
polozky.v: Čierne čižmy má Milly. Tim má green gloves a brown scarf.

polozky.t: Joe's wearing a yellow shirt.
What's Tim wearing? – He's wearing green gloves.
polozky.sk: Čo má Tim na sebe? – Zelené rukavice.

polozky.t: Milly's wearing jeans.
polozky.v: Džínsy má Joe. Milly má red trousers.

polozky.t: Grandma's wearing black boots.
polozky.v: Grandma má a blue skirt a red scarf.

polozky.t: Tim's wearing a brown scarf.
What's Grandma wearing? – She's wearing a blue skirt.
polozky.sk: Čo má babka na sebe? – Modrú sukňu.

svadba-co-robia.uvod: Na svadbe. V tabuľke vidíš, čo kto práve robí. Rozhodni, či veta sedí s tabuľkou.

polozky.t: Grandma's eating the cake.
Mum and Aunt Jane are dancing.
The band is playing music.
What's Milly doing? – She's sleeping.
What's Tim doing? – He's sleeping.
Milly's dancing.
Grandma's talking.
What are Mum and Aunt Jane doing? – They're talking.
polozky.sk: Čo robia mama a teta Jane? – Rozprávajú sa.

polozky.t: Tim's eating the cake.
What's the band doing? – They're playing music.
